page: Microsoft Azure FX64mds_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmdsv2 family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 32 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores running at a base clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The server is equipped with 1344.0 GB of RAM, providing 21.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a 3780 GB disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 70926.61 and a PassMark CPU score of 85402.59, placing it in the top tier. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 392.4 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 170.98 GB/sec for large block write operations, both categorized as top-tier performance. Database operations on PassMark scored 37190.82, and Redis SET operations reached 95.28 million operations per second. Static web serving throughput is recorded at 97.07 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the FX64mds_v2 offers high memory capacity paired with high-frequency compute cores, making it a specialized hardware class. The high ratio of 21.0 GB RAM per core provides significant memory headroom, though single-core CPU performance sits in the average tier with a stress-ng single-core score of 2171.29. This indicates that workloads benefit more from parallel execution and memory-bound operations than single-threaded raw compute. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

The hardware configuration and benchmark profile make this server suitable for memory-intensive databases, large-scale Redis deployments, and high-throughput web serving. The inclusion of AMX and AVX-512 instructions also supports CPU-based machine learning inference, as demonstrated by prompt processing speeds of 292.5 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model.
